scores.rationale: Mechanical validation passed on all checks (applies cleanly, allowlist, question schema) with no warnings. It covers the four named concerns (preference via explicit pairwise statements only, privacy via disclosure/local route/Compartment/retention, precision via exact-value editing and on-demand precision, context via permitted context and binding invalidation). The new decision UBU-D0319 is concise, points at the DESIGN section, and explicitly bounds what it does and does not resolve, deferring device sequencing, mobile workload, audio profiles, evidence, latency and retention to their existing questions. Only the three expected files change and no unrelated edits appear.
